description: This file defines the FilterDonor class within the Goteo project, responsible for constructing SQL queries to filter and retrieve donor user data based on various criteria such as project involvement, call participation, location, donor status, and other filters. It provides methods for calculating donor counts and fetching donor details with applied filters.

classes.name: FilterDonor
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing and executing complex SQL queries to filter donor users based on various criteria, and providing counts and lists of such donors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FilterDonor with a given Filter object.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Builds SQL filter parts and parameter values based on the filter criteria from the Filter object.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Returns the count of donors matching the constructed filter criteria.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Retrieves a list of donor User objects based on filter criteria, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getSqlFilter
methods.description: Returns the SQL query and parameters to filter donors, as a SQL string and associated values.
